What Auto DJ plays and how it sounds.

Intro music
Music made by
Reload the page after changing this.
Hook words: type what the choruses should say. Put a comma between different hooks and the DJ picks one for each song (for example: SELECTA, PARTY TIME, ONE TWO THREE). Speak & Spell only knows about 160 real words and the numbers. Any other word is said by the robot voice (or spelled out letter by letter if you choose Speak & Spell only in the Hook voice menu). You can also make one say a word with your own voice: add a short recording of it in My samples and name the file after the word (BELLS.wav says BELLS).
Sample songs: every song picks a genre, a tempo and key that fit together, real drum kits playing that genre's rhythm, a sub bass tuned to the key, chord loops from the library, and the hook words in the choruses. Songs hand over into each other and the tempo wanders slowly. Choose "Sample songs", then press Auto DJ.

The sounds on the sampler pads, the starter pack and your own files.

Sampler
Each deck has 8 sample pads (the Samples tab when the screen is short). Deck A: keys 1 to 8. Deck B: Q W E R T Y U I. They play through that deck's volume and EQ. Learn one control works on them too.

Connect and teach a MIDI controller.

Last message from your controller: none yet

Guided setup walks through the controls one by one. When a control lights up yellow, press or move the matching control on your deck. Tap Skip for any it does not have. Your choices are remembered on this device. Jog wheel: turn it to nudge the tempo. CUE: hold it to preview, or tap it while playing to restart from the top. Double-tap an EQ or filter knob to centre it.

SMC-PAD pads: Bank A pads are effects, Bank B pads are patterns (the pad's own Bank button picks). Pads 1 to 8 (bottom two rows) are Deck A and pads 9 to 16 (top two rows) are Deck B, read left to right: Intro, Build-up, Drop, Chorus, then Break, Bridge, Half, Outro (effects: Loop 1/4, Loop 1/8, Stutter, Reverse, then Tape stop, Low-pass, High-pass, Echo). Knob bank A (CC 30 to 37): knob 1 crossfader, knob 2 master volume, then the EQ with Deck A on the odd knobs and Deck B on the even knobs: Bass 3 and 4, Mid 5 and 6, Treble 7 and 8. Knob bank B (CC 38 to 45, or the numbers you taught Pad mode on this device): knobs 1 and 2 the same crossfader and master volume, then volumes 3 and 4, filters 5 and 6, tempos 7 and 8. Buttons: < and > (CC 25, 26) sync Deck A to Deck B and Deck B to Deck A, Play (27) and Stop (28) run both decks, Record (29) syncs Deck B to Deck A. If bank B does nothing on your pad, use Learn one control to teach it.
